A feature component over a mostly-future window then simultaneously carries a hypothetical value and an unobserved-support mask, and the spec does not say whether the head uses the hypothetical value, masks it, or attenuates it by observed fraction. As written, the observed-fraction multiplier and frozen backoff make continuation/closure/invitation columns at longer offsets collapse toward the training-marginal backoff regardless of the candidate action, which would neutralize exactly the consequence differences the tables exist to expose.","required_change":"Define an explicit hypothetical-support channel: state per feature component whether hypothetical-extension values are used in head evaluation, how the head's window support is computed for consequence cells (for example, feature evaluation may treat the extension interval as hypothetically supported while §9.4 reporting and stage-2/3/4 fitting never do), and how the observed-fraction/backoff multiplier applies to candidate-versus-default differences. It is unclear which come from the inter-group timing histories versus per-group accent records, what 'overlap fraction' measures, and how each is support-normalized.","required_change":"Give each of the nine components an explicit formula, input source (accent record stream, inter-group histories, articulation state occupancy), support normalization and missing mask, consistent with manifest registration, before stage-2 section-hazard fitting."},{"id":"R6","severity":"low","section":"§9.6 arrival-quantile source fallback","problem":"The fallback 'use the group with greatest stage-1 acoustic assignment support in the current 2 s summary' does not restate the §9.2 residual-table exclusion ('Prototype association and Voice arrival-quantile source: No'). In dense textures the residual slot will frequently have the greatest assignment support, so an implementer faces an apparent conflict between the fallback sentence and the table.","required_change":"State in §9.6 that the fallback ranges over currently resolved groups only, cross-referencing the §9.2 residual participation table, and that when only the residual slot is supported there are no quantile candidates (the body-default opportunity remains available)."},{"id":"R7","severity":"low","section":"§9.3 return-recognition fit","problem":"The predicted yes probability is described as 'the total supported stored-match mass against the no-memory alternative', but retrieval_score_i is a log-scale quantity and the no-memory alternative is 'a fitted constant bias in the same length-normalized retrieval-score competition'.
